ALL RIGHTS BELONG TO MIMI ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33769750]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/33769750[/url] )
check out her other portraits! [penny, alex, abigail, shane [no beard]] ( [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/329/]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/329/[/url] )




Mimi has been gone a long while, and I just couldn't part with her Shane. Thus, I decided to try to update the Shane portrait for her. Hopefully, I didn't butcher him too hard. > <

Should and when Mimi comes back to finish her portraits, she'll be fully granted permission and even encouraged to report me. Because Shane will finally be updated officially and wonderfully! Hopefully, I could play Stardew Valley in jail. ;-;

This is just a temporary substitute for when she comes back. I hope you enjoy Mimi's Portrait of Shane just as much as I do!

This Shane portrait could be downloaded as a content patcher folder or an xnb file. Both work.




:D SHANE AND MIMI ARE AWESOME!
